name: agent-brain
description: Persistent cognition store for AI coding agents (Postgres + pgvector + hybrid retrieval + agent-driven reasoning helpers). 19 brain-* skills cover capture, recall, structured reasoning, contextual ingest, failure-memory, session lifecycle, compliance, usage discipline, staleness. 5 obsidian-* skills retained for vault interop.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent cognition store for any coding agent — Postgres + pgvector + hybrid retrieval + agent-driven reasoning.
interface.longDescription: Coding agents waste time and context every session rediscovering knowledge — architecture, APIs, prior decisions, recurring gotchas. Agent Brain gives them a Postgres-backed persistent memory with hybrid retrieval (FTS + BGE-M3 + RRF + mxbai cross-encoder), agent-driven reasoning helpers (summarize/compare/cite/revise with grounded JSON schemas + DB cache), and brain-rot defenses (provenance-aware down-weighting + per-bucket tau abstain). No Anthropic API key required — the calling agent IS the LLM.
